_comment: The advanced hunting queries the kit runs through runHuntingQuery. 'source' says where each comes from: the Defender XDR implementation guide's Validate step (which takes it from Microsoft Learn), or the kit (a per-device form of the guide's query, so the result can be joined to the inventory). 'columns' are the columns the kit reads; a response without one of them fails the run rather than reading as empty. Advanced hunting keeps 30 days of data (Learn, 'Monitor attack surface reduction (ASR) rule activity'). Table and column names from Learn's DeviceInfo, DeviceEvents, DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities, AlertEvidence and AlertInfo references, read November 11, 2026.

coverage-summary.kql: DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(1d) | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceId | where OSPlatform startswith "Windows" | summarize Devices = count() by OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState

coverage-devices.source: Kit: the guide's G2 query, one row per device
coverage-devices.kql: DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(1d) | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceId | where OSPlatform startswith "Windows" | project DeviceId, DeviceName, OSPlatform, OnboardingStatus, SensorHealthState, MachineGroup, Timestamp

prevention-events.kql: DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where ActionType in ('ExploitGuardNetworkProtectionAudited','ExploitGuardNetworkProtectionBlocked','ControlledFolderAccessViolationAudited','ControlledFolderAccessViolationBlocked','TamperingAttempt') | summarize Events = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by ActionType

asr-events.kql: DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | where ActionType startswith "Asr" | summarize EventCount=count() by ActionType

asr-events-by-device.source: Kit: the guide's G4 query by device and file path, so each audit hit can be matched to an exclusion or a decision
asr-events-by-device.kql: DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d) | where ActionType startswith "Asr" | summarize Events = count(), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by ActionType, DeviceName, FolderPath

tvm-high-critical.kql: DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities | where VulnerabilitySeverityLevel in ("Critical", "High") | summarize CVEs = dcount(CveId), Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, RecommendedSecurityUpdate | order by Devices desc

exposed-devices.kql: DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(1d) | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by DeviceId | where ExposureLevel == "High" or IsInternetFacing == true | project DeviceName, ExposureLevel, IsInternetFacing, AssetValue, MachineGroup

cross-source-users.kql: AlertEvidence | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | where EntityType == "User" and isnotempty(AccountObjectId) | join kind=inner (AlertInfo | project AlertId, Title, Severity) on AlertId | summarize Sources = dcount(ServiceSource), SourceList = make_set(ServiceSource), Alerts = dcount(AlertId) by AccountObjectId, AccountUpn | where Sources > 1 | order by Sources desc, Alerts desc
